title: runner watch accepts a process whose command line only names a file called CLAUDE.md, so the claude guard admits a pid that is no claude session
goal: runner watch ends only a process whose program (the first word of its command line, or the interpreter's script word) is named claude, so a process that merely has a CLAUDE.md or claude.json argument is refused with exit 2

run:
import os,subprocess,sys,tempfile,pathlib as P
d=P.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());r=d/"r.txt";r.write_text("x");os.utime(r,(1,1))
p=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,"-c","import time;time.sleep(60)","CLAUDE.md"])
try:
    a=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/backlog.py","runner","watch","--pid",str(p.pid),"--report",str(r),"--stale","0"],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=90)
    ok=a.returncode==2
finally:
    p.kill()
print(a.returncode,a.stderr[-200:])
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import os,stat,subprocess,sys,tempfile,time,pathlib as P
d=P.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());c=d/"claude";c.write_text("#!/bin/sh\nsleep 60\n");c.chmod(0o755)
r=d/"r.txt";r.write_text("x");os.utime(r,(1,1))
p=subprocess.Popen(["/bin/sh",str(c)])
try:
    time.sleep(1)
    a=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/backlog.py","runner","watch","--pid",str(p.pid),"--report",str(r),"--stale","0"],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=90)
    time.sleep(1)
    ok=a.returncode==0 and "sent SIGTERM" in a.stdout and p.poll() is not None
finally:
    if p.poll() is None: p.kill()
print(ok,a.returncode,a.stdout[-200:])
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

gates.question: How does names_claude decide a pid is a claude session: which word and which names?
options: program word named claude or claude.exe, interpreters skipped
gates.recommendation: program word named claude or claude.exe, interpreters skipped
gates.reason: first word of the command line, or the script word after sh, bash, node, python and the like; code options -c -e -m refuse

notes: Found by the SP-f7kaebel review (S3): bl_procs.names_claude takes any argv word whose basename starts with claude, case-insensitively; the gate answer recorded for ST-hlbnqk7k chose that rule against a plain substring, but a word CLAUDE.md still matches. Runs as the agent s guard only; the repro fails on the base. Raised to S2 by the 2026-10-25 run brief: the guard decides which process gets SIGTERM. Plan 2026-10-25: premise reproduced (the repro exits 0 on today's base, expected 2). The second check, a planted /bin/sh script named claude that runner watch must still end with SIGTERM, passes before the work on purpose: it pins the behaviour the fix must keep. Fix sketch: names_claude accepts the first word of the command line when its basename is claude (claude.exe too), or the first non-option word after an interpreter word; never a later argument. Gate g1 (class agents-rule) answered with its recommendation (option 1), pre-approved by the operator for the 2026-10-25 run; answered by the sprint runner for the operator.
